Regarding appointment cancellations, we sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused. Unfortunately, there are times when appointments have to be cancelled at short notice due to unforeseen circumstances, such as staff sickness-which was the case in this circumstance. We make every effort to try and get cover but this isn't always possible. We always do our best to inform patients as quickly as possible and to offer alternative arrangements.
Please contact the surgery, and we will be happy to schedule your appointment as soon as possible.
With regards to the incorrect vaccine being administered, i know you have already spoken with the nurse, who apologised and assured you that this was not something that could cause you harm and apologised for the human error (which incidentally has never happened before in her 10 years of working at the practice) and also the complaints manager about this already.
Thank you for sharing your feedback as it helps us to improve the service we provide to all our patients and once again i am sorry that these two experiences have affected your opinions on the surgery.

Please do feel free to contact us via our website so we can offer more personalised feedback.
Kind regards,
Francis Grove Surgery Management Team
